name: banner
title: Banner
description: A thin, full-width bar above the site header for a message that applies to the whole site: "This site is still being written", a scheduled outage, a new release. One line of text, an optional link, and an optional close button.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/banner

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/banner.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/banner';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/banner

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
